rounds.diagnosis: All 28 production model-request observations lacked Darmanitan CSV10C_041 on the player's Bench and lacked the strict verified attack suffix required by public_partner_same_turn_prize_breakpoint. The closest public state is seed 800018505, player 1, turn 14: Darumaka CSV10C_040 is in hand, the player has two prizes remaining, and the opponent presents a two-prize Iron Hands ex Active plus a four-Pokemon Bench, but the compact frontier contains no Darumaka Bench candidate. Both Rule and V18CPG instead evolve Active Zorua, attach Darkness, use Trade, play N's PP Up, Bench Munkidori, play Energy Switch, and attack. By turn 16 both Darumaka and Darmanitan are in the public discard, so the copy source can no longer be established. The interaction owner therefore had no eligible certificate to execute; this is a source-building frontier gap before the interaction bridge, not an interaction-owner failure.

rounds.diagnosis: The earliest winner-changing public failure was seed 800018506. On turn 3 Rule consumed an unbound Boss's Orders while the deck had no payable attack, pulling an energized Raichu without gaining a Prize; the first certificate revision merely delayed Boss until after Rigid Band and Artazon, so it failed the real complete-turn lifecycle. After fixing turn 3 to end without Boss, the error moved to turn 5: the preserved Boss again consumed the Supporter quota while Iono could open an information checkpoint whose resulting public hand enabled Darkness attachment and a payable attack. The final fix therefore needed two separate public proofs: a complete attackless gust-hold suffix and an information-epoch handoff that certifies only Iono, never its unknown draw result.

Other active V18 module certificates therefore fell through to Rule interaction picks even after their route advantage was independently proven. A second exact public line was also reconstructed from the old loss trace: full-HP DD Zoroark, two Zorua on Bench, Night Stretcher in hand, one Reshiram in public discard, and a 30-HP two-Prize Raikou Active. The safe sequence is Night Stretcher -> uniquely recover public Reshiram -> reobserve -> Bench Reshiram -> reobserve -> Rule-exact 170-damage Night Joker KO; it must not be flattened across either public-state checkpoint.
